sampling_correction.old_behavior: Deterministic full-epoch permutation of all 236 subjects (every subject visited exactly once per epoch)
sampling_correction.new_behavior: Independent Bernoulli trial per subject record per optimizer step with inclusion probability q=1/236

variable_batch_support.empty_batch_handling: Zero gradient initialized, calibrated Gaussian noise added, optimizer stepped, privacy budget tracked
variable_batch_support.multi_sample_handling: Per-sample forward-backward with sequential L2 gradient clipping to C=1.0, accumulation into gradient buffer, calibrated Gaussian noise added
variable_batch_support.single_sample_handling: Single sample forward-backward with L2 clipping to C=1.0, calibrated Gaussian noise added

accounting_correction.old_accountant: Truncated Taylor RDP Approximation: RDP(alpha) = alpha * q^2 / (2 * sigma^2)
accounting_correction.old_flaw: Underestimated Rényi divergence by 13.4x at sigma=0.50 due to truncated exp(1/sigma^2)-1 ~ 1/sigma^2 assumption
accounting_correction.new_accountant: Exact Analytical Rényi Differential Privacy (Poisson Subsampled Gaussian RDP via Mironov et al. 2019 Theorem 2)
accounting_correction.new_formula: D_alpha = 1/(alpha - 1) * ln( sum_{k=0}^alpha binom(alpha, k) * (1-q)^{alpha-k} * q^k * exp( k*(k-1)/(2*sigma^2) ) ) computed via stable log-sum-exp

independent_cross_check.method: Numerical integration of Gaussian mixture density ratio via Gauss-Hermite / SciPy quad
